test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Beat around the bush

options.text: To avoid talking about what is important
To take on a task that is way too big
To do something without any hesitation

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Beat around the bush"** means to avoid talking about what is important. (मुद्दे की बात को टालना)

 
 
• **Example:** Stop** beating around the bush** and tell me what really happened.
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** This idiom is used when someone is not addressing the main issue and is instead talking about things that are not relevant. (यह मुहावरा तब इस्तेमाल होता है जब कोई व
